## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm build` and `pnpm typecheck` pass
- [ ] `pnpm test` (and `pnpm test:scripts` if relevant) pass
- [ ] `pnpm lint:deps` passes (framework packages don't import the AGPL server/collab packages)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or the `build.md` format changed
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, per the DCO in CONTRIBUTING.md)
